lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Teacher! Teacher!
What's the matter, Anne?

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Rapi, Anis, Neon, and I

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: made croquettes.
That's amazing!

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Rapi and I peeled the potatoes together,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: but it was really difficult since it was my first time T_T

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: I think Rapi struggled a bit too,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: so some potatoes ended up only half-sized.
Is peeling potatoes really that difficult?

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: I was told that you have to peel away quite a bit

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: to remove the sprout because it's toxic.
I think it's just because the two of you are inexperienced.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: after that, we prepared the filling.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Anis said the secret for great taste is carbonated soda,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: so I put in a whole bunch.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Too much, apparently...

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: because Anis ended up yelling at me.
I can picture that, hehe.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: As for Neon,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: she said that if you fry the croquettes with maximum firepower,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: it would remove all the carbonation.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: But she may have gone a bit overboard, 'cause the fire got so strong it reached the ceiling and scorched them.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Then suddenly, it started raining inside somehow.
Did any of you get hurt?
Sounds like the fire sprinkler is triggered.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: We're fine!

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Fire sprinkler?

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: What's that?
It's a safety system that sprays water everywhere in case there's a fire.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: I'm not surprised that you know that. You know everything!

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: It was quite challenging for a few moments,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: but we managed to finish the croquettes!

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: There's somewhat burnt and hard,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: but considering it's our first time making croquettes together,

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: I'd still call it a success! ^__^
I'm glad you were able to finish them.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: I was thinking about having some with you, Teacher.
I'll be waiting in the Commander's Room.

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: Woohoo!

lines.speaker: n102
lines.text: I'll be right there!
